## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No real student data, institutional workbook, database, backup, credential, or
      private screenshot is included
- [ ] Missing, zero, and special states remain semantically distinct
- [ ] Database changes include migration and restart-persistence coverage
- [ ] Excel changes prove non-target package fidelity and source non-overwrite
- [ ] Documentation, changelog, runbook, and project memory are updated where needed
